id: title:Gilbert09:feed the liveness tracker on every task queue

review.posthog_relevance: Checks the Temporal worker's task queue against a supported set before starting the health check server, potentially preventing worker failures and data loss if the queue is unsupported.
review.reason: Adds a runtime check to refuse starting the health server if the Temporal worker's task queue is not covered by the supported set, removing Django settings and adding relevant imports. This could prevent a worker from starting with a potentially broken health check, which could lead to worker failures and loss of data.

The benefit relies on unverified outcomes.
